historical_import_context: Trusted completed producer context must authenticate each source/command/receipt association; current file hashes alone cannot establish historical imports. Exact trusted argv may name an entrypoint without the imported module path.
source_identity_rules: Both v2 sources join outside-publication/symlink/single-link metadata preflight, known size before every hash, complete-seal-before-content, and pre/post snapshots; shared references to one immutable file are allowed.

native_binary.qualification: Historical macOS artifact identity only, not a universal portable binary pin; a future operator needs separately reviewed native provenance

python_dependencies: Standard library plus co-located process_memory.py imported by guard_common.py; no extra producer adapter or provider client installed
supervision_scope: Synchronous known worker/native-child lifetime only; not parent-exit/orphan-aware production supervision
admission_note: New coordinator bytes require a NEW independently reviewed full-profile digest and exact source-commit admission. No prior profile/source permission is relabeled or supplied by packaging.
